> 第5章 炼化金乌天火（第1页）
李天也不再犹豫，直接走了进去，三方人马看着突然出现的人。
周杰和火神子看着到来的人，只知道服饰是元神宗门的人。
而元神宗的人则是知道此人是谁，很久以前的外门榜首。后面不知道怎么滴不能修炼了，被外门很多人嘲讽废物天才李天。
看着李天的到来，张远呵斥道。李天你来干嘛，一个不能修炼的废物。这里不是你能参与的。
根本没把李天放在眼里，这里俨然宝物只是他们三个人的，其余手下只是陪衬。
看着被呵斥的人，周杰嘲讽道。哟，欺负自己同门师弟，真的是脸皮够无耻的。
李天当即反驳，一个同门师兄还不如外人、只知道内讧。
被李天这么一说，再加上周杰的嘲讽。张远脸都黑了下来，那种阴狠一闪而逝。不再说话。
李天看着那高台上的一团火苗。也看看三方人，谁也没有敢上前去争夺，生怕出现生命危险。就等谁不怕死的先去试探，才能有把握不出现意外。
富贵险中求，当初自己连丹田都废了还能苟活于世。何况现在宝物就在眼前。李天毫不犹豫走向火苗。
后面的人都眼睁睁的看着李天接近那团火。既然有人试探，大家何而不乐，只要他拿出宝物，就抢下。这是这群人心里的想法。
李天哪管他们怎么想，只是一步一步的靠近，那种热浪接踵而至。热得他汗如雨下。拼命的用灵力结成一个防护罩抵抗着。
看着他的用灵力结成的防护罩，众人眼睛一亮，刚刚听张远说他不是不能修行的废物吗？怎么还有灵力，没有灵力没有丹田怎么储存的灵力，众人眼睛里满是疑惑。
就在这时李天已经靠近火苗了，伸手一抓。把火苗抓在手里，吓得他赶紧缩回手。烫得把手烧得漆黑。
众人看到这一幕，纷纷大吃一惊，还好自己没有上前抢夺。
而李天再次用灵力包裹住手去抓住火苗，一下子消失不见了。洞内温度骤然下降，没有了那种炽热感，跟外面温度一样。
看着消失的李天，众人赶紧上前去寻找，找了半天没找到，嘴里脏话满天飞。
另一边的李天被传送到另一个空间，那火苗不再炙热，而在李天身边跳动。

看着前面跳动的火苗，李天不再犹豫，开始运转灵力炼化。随着时间推移，慢慢的、慢慢的、火苗被炼化。
李天也终于知道这火苗为啥在这里了。这火苗叫金乌天火。原来是有主的。老人叫天火老人。一身火属性功法出神入化。已达天神境中期。再进一步就是天神巅峰。但是由于身藏天火。被一位炼丹师看中，想夺其天火，本来天火已被炼化，已和主人成为一体，剥离本命天火等于要了半条命。实力十不存一，天火老人哪里可肯交出，就这样被哪位炼丹师联合几位天神巅峰境强者一路追杀，身负重伤，陨落于此。
失去主人的金乌天火，再次成为了无主之物。慢慢的诞生了灵智。就在刚刚诞生灵智的一瞬间，能量四溢。导致被修炼者查到，所以才引起别人的窥视。还好只是一丝灵智。犹如孩童一样的，很久没人跟他沟通了，见到自己也不害怕。所以才会如此温和，炼化起来也没啥问题。

> Chapter 5 Refining the Golden Crow Sky Fire (Page 1)
Li Tian no longer hesitated and walked in directly. The three parties looked at the person who suddenly appeared.
Zhou Jie and Huo Shenzi looked at the people arriving and only knew that they were from the Yuanshen Sect.
The people of Yuanshen Sect know who this person is, and he was the top of the outer sect a long time ago. Later, I don’t know why I couldn’t practice anymore, and many people in the outer sect ridiculed the useless genius Li Tian.
Seeing Li Tian's arrival, Zhang Yuan scolded. Li Tian, ​​what are you doing here, a loser who can't practice? This is not something you can participate in.
They didn't take Li Tian seriously at all. It was as if the treasures here only belonged to the three of them, and the rest of his men were just foils.
Looking at the person being scolded, Zhou Jie mocked. Oh, it's really shameless to bully your fellow junior.
Li Tian immediately retorted, saying that a fellow disciple is not as good as an outsider and only knows internal strife.
What Li Tian said and Zhou Jie's ridicule. Zhang Yuan's face turned dark, and the viciousness disappeared in a flash. No more talking.
Li Tian looked at a ball of flames on the high platform. Looking at the three parties, no one dared to step forward to fight for it, for fear of risking their lives. Just wait for those who are not afraid of death to test it first, so that you can be sure that there will be no accidents.
Wealth and honor are obtained in danger, and even my Dantian was destroyed and I was still able to survive in this world. Besides, the treasure is right in front of you now. Li Tian walked toward the flames without hesitation.
The people behind watched helplessly as Li Tian approached the fire. Since someone is testing him, why wouldn't everyone be happy? As long as he takes out the treasure, they will grab it. This is what these people are thinking.
Li Tiantian didn't care what they thought, he just got closer step by step, and that kind of heat wave came one after another. The heat made him sweat profusely. He desperately used his spiritual power to form a protective shield to resist.
Looking at his protective shield made of spiritual power, everyone's eyes lit up. Didn't they just hear Zhang Yuan say that he was a waste who couldn't practice? Why is there still spiritual power? How can he store spiritual power without spiritual power and his Dantian? Everyone's eyes are full of doubts.
At this moment, Li Tian was already close to the flames and stretched out his hand to grab it. Holding the flame in his hand, he quickly retracted his hand in fright. It was so hot that my hands were burned black.
Everyone was shocked when they saw this scene, but luckily they didn't step forward to snatch it.
And Li Tian once again wrapped his hand with spiritual power to catch the flames, and suddenly disappeared. The temperature inside the cave dropped suddenly, and there was no longer that burning feeling, it was the same as the temperature outside.
Seeing Li Tian disappearing, everyone hurried forward to look for him. After searching for a long time, they couldn't find him, and swear words were flying all over the place.
Li Tian on the other side was teleported to another space. The flames were no longer hot, but were beating around Li Tian.
Looking at the flames dancing in front of him, Li Tian no longer hesitated and started to refine his spiritual power. As time goes by, slowly, slowly, the fire is refined.
Li Tian finally knew why the flames were here. This flame is called the Golden Crow Sky Fire. It turns out there is an owner. The old man's name is Old Man Tianhuo. His fire-attribute skills are superb. It has reached the middle stage of the Heavenly God Realm. One step further is the peak of the gods. But because he is hiding in heavenly fire. He was spotted by an alchemist who wanted to take away his Heavenly Fire. Originally, the Heavenly Fire had been refined and became one with its owner. To strip away the original Heavenly Fire would be like killing half of his life. His strength was extremely low, so how could Old Man Tianhuo be willing to hand it over? Just like that, he was hunted down by an alchemist and several powerful men at the peak of the gods. He was seriously injured and died here.
The Golden Crow Sky Fire lost its owner and became ownerless again. Slowly spiritual wisdom was born. At the moment when spiritual wisdom is born, energy overflows. As a result, it was discovered by practitioners, so it attracted the prying eyes of others. Fortunately, it was just a hint of intelligence. Just like a child, no one has communicated with him for a long time, and he is not afraid when he sees him. That's why it's so gentle, and there's no problem in refining it.
